g.text: "board.drl" does not state its coordinate format, so circuitRF inferred one: inch 2:4
leading zeros suppressed. Confirm it, or correct it — a drill file read at the wrong
scale puts every hole in the wrong place, and nothing downstream will say so.
Units: inch — INFERRED from the tool table (0.0118); the file does not say.
Digit format: 2:4 — DEFAULTED for inch; the file declares no format.
Zero suppression: leading zeros suppressed — DEFAULTED; the file carries no LZ/TZ
Drill data agrees with the artwork: all 2 hits fall inside the artwork extent, and the two
spans differ by a factor of 0.87 in X and 0.769 in Y.
